name: ichimok2005
summary: This EA trades based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator system, generating buy and sell signals from the interplay of the Tenkan-sen, Kijun-sen, Senkou Span A/B, and Chikou Span. It enters positions when price breaks above or below the cloud (Kumo) and confirms with Tenkan/Kijun crossovers and Chikou Span alignment. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture sustained directional moves while using the cloud as a dynamic support/resistance zone.
summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）指标系统进行交易，通过转换线、基准线、先行带A/B和迟行线的相互关系产生买卖信号。当价格突破云层（Kumo）时入场，并结合转换线/基准线交叉及迟行线确认。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情，同时利用云层作为动态支撑/阻力区域。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件包括：价格突破云层（Kumo）上方做多，突破云层下方做空；转换线（Tenkan-sen）上穿基准线（Kijun-sen）为买入信号，下穿为卖出信号；迟行线（Chikou Span）需与价格方向一致以确认趋势强度。出场条件通常包括价格回落至云层内部或另一侧、转换线与基准线反向交叉、以及迟行线失去确认作用。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理上，EA依赖云层的厚度和位置作为天然的止损参考，云层越厚代表支撑/阻力越强。整体策略适合中长线趋势行情，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator. Entry conditions include: going long when price breaks above the Kumo cloud and going short when it breaks below; a Tenkan-sen crossing above Kijun-sen generates a buy signal while crossing below generates a sell signal; the Chikou Span must align with the price direction to confirm trend strength. Exit conditions typically involve price falling back into or through the cloud, a reverse Tenkan/Kijun crossover, or loss of Chikou Span confirmation. Position sizing may use fixed lots or an equity-based calculation method. For money management, the EA relies on cloud thickness and position as natural stop-loss references, where thicker clouds represent stronger support/resistance. The overall strategy is suitable for medium-to-long-term trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in ranging conditions leading to consecutive losses.

pros: 一目均衡表是多维度指标，同时提供趋势方向、支撑阻力和动量信息，分析框架完整
云层（Kumo）提供动态支撑/阻力区域，比固定止损更适应市场变化
多条件确认（云层突破+线交叉+迟行线）减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
pros_en: Ichimoku is a multi-dimensional indicator providing trend direction, support/resistance, and momentum simultaneously, offering a complete analytical framework
The Kumo cloud provides dynamic support/resistance zones that adapt to market changes better than fixed stop-losses
Multi-condition confirmation (cloud breakout + line crossover + Chikou Span alignment) reduces false signals and improves entry quality
cons: 在震荡行情中一目均衡表会产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁开仓和平仓亏损
默认止损为0意味着没有硬性风险控制，在极端行情下可能遭受巨大损失
指标参数固定（9/26/52），缺乏自适应机制，不同品种和周期可能需要不同参数优化
cons_en: Ichimoku generates numerous false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent opening and closing of positions at a loss
Default stop-loss of 0 means no hard risk control, potentially suffering massive losses in extreme market conditions
Fixed indicator parameters (9/26/52) lack adaptive mechanisms; different instruments and timeframes may require different parameter optimization
improvements: 增加云层厚度过滤条件，当云层过薄时跳过交易信号以避免震荡市假突破
添加硬性止损机制，至少以云层边界作为止损参考，避免无限制亏损
improvements_en: Add a cloud thickness filter to skip trading signals when the cloud is too thin, avoiding false breakouts in ranging markets
Implement a hard stop-loss mechanism, at minimum using the cloud boundary as a stop-loss reference to prevent unlimited losses

risk_points: 默认止损为0，缺乏硬性风险控制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
震荡市场中频繁假突破信号导致连续小额亏损累积
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 lacks hard risk control, potentially leading to significant losses in extreme market conditions
Frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets lead to accumulated consecutive small losses
